# About this item

* INTELLIGENT NOISE CONTROL — Active Noise Cancellation removes up to 2x more background noise. Transparency mode lets you hear the world around you, and Adaptive Audio seamlessly blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode for the best listening experience in any environment. And when you’re speaking with someone nearby, Conversation Awareness automatically lowers the volume of what’s playing.
* IMPROVED SOUND AND CALL QUALITY — The Apple-designed H2 chip helps to create deeply immersive sound. The low-distortion, custom-built driver delivers crisp, clear high notes and full, rich bass in stunning definition. Voice Isolation improves the quality of phone calls in loud conditions.
* CUSTOMISABLE FIT — Includes four pairs of silicone tips (XS, S, M, L) to fit a wide range of ear shapes and provide all-day comfort. The tips create an acoustic seal to help keep out noise and secure AirPods Pro 2 in place.
* DUST, SWEAT AND WATER RESISTANT — Both AirPods Pro and the MagSafe Charging Case are IP54 dust, sweat and water resistant, so you can listen comfortably in more conditions.
* PERSONALISED SPATIAL AUDIO — With sound that suits your unique ear shape along with dynamic head tracking, AirPods Pro 2 deliver an immersive listening experience that places sound all around you. You can also listen to selected songs, shows and movies in Dolby Atmos.
* A HIGHER LEVEL OF CONTROL — Simply swipe, press and hold the stem to manage playback functions using Touch control. And with Siri Interactions, simply nod your head yes or shake your head no when Siri asks if you’d like to hear a message, answer a call or manage a notification.
* LONG BATTERY LIFE — Get up to 6 hours of listening time with Active Noise Cancellation enabled. And get up to 30 hours of total listening time with Active Noise Cancellation enabled, using the case.
* A MORE CAPABLE CASE — Keep track of AirPods Pro 2 with Precision Finding and a built-in speaker. A lanyard loop helps keep your AirPods Pro 2 close. Charge with an Apple Watch or MagSafe Charger, USB-C Charge Cable or Qi-certified charger.

## Product description

Unlike traditional, circular earbuds, the design of the EarPods is defined by the geometry of the ear. Which makes them more comfortable for more people than any other earbud-style headphones.

How are ratings calculated?

### Customers say

Customers praise the headphones' sound quality, with one noting they can hear more instruments in songs, and appreciate their noise cancellation and perfect fit in the ear. The connectivity receives mixed feedback - while some report seamless connection with MacBook and iPhone, others experience disconnections with Apple products. Moreover, the functionality, authenticity, and battery life are also mixed aspects, with some units working well while others stop working within a month, and some customers receiving fake products. Value for money opinions are divided between those who find it worth the expense and those who consider it not value for money.

Amazon Customer

*5 out of 5 stars*

##### Works Exactly How You’d Expect With Apple

Really solid packaging and everything arrived in perfect condition. My biggest concern was ending up with a clone, but this is genuine. Definitely check the seller ratings before ordering. I also opted for AppleCare+ at ₹149 per month after setting it up. In addition to 1 year brand warranty which we get. Not necessary, but good peace of mind. Coming to the product itself, the quality is excellent. The audio output is crisp, immersive, and consistent. It switches seamlessly between my Mac and iPhone, which makes daily use effortless. Battery life easily gives me 6+ hours on a single charge, and with the case, I can stretch it to around 4 to 5 days of regular usage. Overall, very happy with the purchase. Great value for the price.

  Have been using the 2nd Gen AirPods Pro I bought from Amazon for about a month. Amazed by the sound quality & noise cancellation. Nothing else out there matches the AirPods Pro. I still have my AirPods 3 which I purchased 2 years ago and liked a lot. But the downsides are the microphone quality and the fact that it doesn't block outside noise, which is very inconvenient during online office meetings. This is why I bought the Pro and I am glad that it made a huge difference. 95% of the outside noise is blocked during calls and no one complained of not hearing my voice clearly, as the Pro isolates background noise from my voice and it is rendered in crystal clarity to the other persons. Even movie watching or song listening is an unparalleled experience with the Pro. Also we get a braided USB C cable with this, which is of high quality. Overall, satisifed with my purchase.

  Reviewed in India on 16 June 2025

  Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

  Awesome and Unbeatable!

  Please read this review – it’s worth it!

  I’ve been using this product for the past year, and it’s absolutely amazing.

  Two days ago, I had an incident where I dropped one of my AirPods into a gutter filled with water. I thought I had lost it for good because the gutter was covered with an iron lid and was on a busy street. I had no way to get it back, so I went home feeling hopeless.

  The next day, I started thinking about how to replace a single AirPod. Then I tried tracking its location—and to my surprise, it showed the exact spot where I lost it! That gave me some hope.

  I rushed back to the location and, after 17 hours, somehow managed to get it out. I was shocked to see that it still worked! I let it dry for 24 hours, and now I’m using it again—it’s working perfectly fine.

  It’s truly amazing to see such a high-quality product!

## About this Item

* INTELLIGENT NOISE CONTROL — Active Noise Cancellation removes up to 2x more background noise. Transparency mode lets you hear the world around you, and Adaptive Audio seamlessly blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode for the best listening experience in any environment. And when you’re speaking with someone nearby, Conversation Awareness automatically lowers the volume of what’s playing.
* IMPROVED SOUND AND CALL QUALITY — The Apple-designed H2 chip helps to create deeply immersive sound. The low-distortion, custom-built driver delivers crisp, clear high notes and full, rich bass in stunning definition. Voice Isolation improves the quality of phone calls in loud conditions.
* CUSTOMISABLE FIT — Includes four pairs of silicone tips (XS, S, M, L) to fit a wide range of ear shapes and provide all-day comfort. The tips create an acoustic seal to help keep out noise and secure AirPods Pro 2 in place.
* DUST, SWEAT AND WATER RESISTANT — Both AirPods Pro and the MagSafe Charging Case are IP54 dust, sweat and water resistant, so you can listen comfortably in more conditions.
* PERSONALISED SPATIAL AUDIO — With sound that suits your unique ear shape along with dynamic head tracking, AirPods Pro 2 deliver an immersive listening experience that places sound all around you. You can also listen to selected songs, shows and movies in Dolby Atmos.
* A HIGHER LEVEL OF CONTROL — Simply swipe, press and hold the stem to manage playback functions using Touch control. And with Siri Interactions, simply nod your head yes or shake your head no when Siri asks if you’d like to hear a message, answer a call or manage a notification.
* LONG BATTERY LIFE — Get up to 6 hours of listening time with Active Noise Cancellation enabled. And get up to 30 hours of total listening time with Active Noise Cancellation enabled, using the case.
* A MORE CAPABLE CASE — Keep track of AirPods Pro 2 with Precision Finding and a built-in speaker. A lanyard loop helps keep your AirPods Pro 2 close. Charge with an Apple Watch or MagSafe Charger, USB-C Charge Cable or Qi-certified charger.

## Product description

Unlike traditional, circular earbuds, the design of the EarPods is defined by the geometry of the ear. Which makes them more comfortable for more people than any other earbud-style headphones.
